meta.description: Compute and interpret VCF quality-control metrics (Ti/Tv, het/hom, novel/known, missingness, HWE, contamination, relatedness) with bcftools stats, vcftools, plot-vcfstats, and identity tools (somalier, peddy, KING). Use when judging whether a callset is trustworthy, diagnosing a low Ti/Tv or outlier het/hom sample, deciding whether an HWE deviation is error or biology, screening a cohort for sample swaps/contamination/wrong-sex before analysis, or comparing call sets before and after filtering. Not for applying filters (see variant-calling/filtering-best-practices) or normalizing representation (see variant-calling/variant-normalization).
meta.execution_note: Mode A. Windows bcftools 1.24 (plugins via BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS); WSL agents distro via tar hand-over: bcftools 1.21, vcftools 0.1.17, cyvcf2 0.34.0 and matplotlib 3.11.2 (plot-vcfstats), somalier 0.3.5, peddy 0.4.8. Data SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py, seed 20260911): 8-sample raw callset with SYN_S6 low coverage, SYN_S7 ~15 % contaminated, SYN_S8 a duplicate of SYN_S3, and 6 excess-het paralog sites. peddy could not run on the synthetic 35-kb genome (needs human sites/chrX); VerifyBamID2/CHARR need BAM/gVCF input and were not run. Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 35.6/40, Layer-2 avg 51.6/60, assertion pass rate 18/20 (90%).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; references (Danecek 2011/2021, Wigginton 2005, Manichaikul 2010, Pedersen 2017/2020, Zhang 2020) are real.

methodological_ground.detail: HWE excess-only, controls-only and within-ancestry rules are correct; the het-AB one-liner computes the wrong quantity (P2) but the per-sample method the Skill describes is sound.

code_usability.detail: All commands and the shipped example ran; plot-vcfstats produced PNGs and failed only at the PDF step.

functional_suitability.note: Metric table verified on data: TSTV field 5, PSC column 14 = nMissing, ExcessHet>54.69 flagged exactly the 6 planted paralog sites, and gtcheck, vcftools --relatedness2 and somalier all found the S3/S8 duplicate. One wrong idiom: the quick het-AB one-liner prints [%AD] for all samples without separators, so the awk mean is 0.729 against true per-sample means of 0.42-0.49.

reliability.note: Common Errors table is accurate (gtcheck -G removal confirmed: "The option -G, --GTs-only has been deprecated"); plot-vcfstats also needs pdflatex or tectonic (exit 2 without), which is not mentioned.

performance_context.note: 225-line SKILL.md; usage guide holds the Python extensions.

agent_usability.note: Order-of-operations and ancestry-stratification rules are explicit; the HWE excess-only rule was demonstrated (two-sided HWE p<0.05 flagged 10 real hom-alt sites).

human_usability.note: Prompts map to sections; decision table readable.

maintainability.note: Runnable example (vcf_stats.py prints usage without an argument); no test data.

agent_specific.note: Clear trigger and hand-offs to filtering/normalization; identity QC flagged as mandatory before association.

recommendations.title: Het allele-balance one-liner mixes all samples
recommendations.problem: `bcftools query -i 'GT="het"' -f '[%AD]\n'` prints every sample's AD with no separator and selects a site if any sample is het, so the awk mean (0.729 here) is meaningless.
recommendations.root_cause: Per-sample FORMAT extraction without a sample separator or per-sample het restriction.
recommendations.fix: Use `-f '[%SAMPLE\t%GT\t%AD\n]'` and average alt/(ref+alt) per sample over 0/1 genotypes only.

recommendations.title: plot-vcfstats needs pdflatex or tectonic
recommendations.problem: plot-vcfstats exits 2 at the PDF step without pdflatex/tectonic; only matplotlib is listed.
recommendations.fix: Add pdflatex/tectonic to prerequisites and the Common Errors table; note that PNGs are still written.

recommendations.title: State the site-panel needs of peddy and somalier
recommendations.problem: peddy fails on non-human or small targets; somalier needs a sites file matched to the build.
recommendations.fix: Note the bundled human site panels, chrX requirement, and `somalier find-sites` for custom targets.
